items.title: Rashied Ali and Henry Grimes interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 30, 2009
items.q: Tucker, that’s the drummer I was trying to tell you, Ronald Tucker. That’s the drummer I was trying to think about the other day, he was from down your way, right?

ctx.x: Yeah. I’m familiar with it as, you know —

See Market Street divided North Philly and South Philly, and I lived on the north side of Market Street, Henry lived on the south side, which was, you know, like Jimmy Heath and all those guys from there were from down that way. And Tootie and all those guys. Tucker, that’s the drummer I was trying to tell you, Ronald Tucker. That’s the drummer I was trying to think about the other day, he was from down your way, right?
Yeah, Ronald Tucker, but I was thinking of another one, another guy. I know Ronald Tucker was one that was —
